title: Wall Street Giants Invest $500 Billion in AI Infrastructure
subtitle: Nvidia partners with major financial firms to build the future of artificial intelligence.

summary.en: Nvidia has announced a massive $500 billion deal with six major Wall Street firms to fund artificial intelligence infrastructure. This partnership aims to build the data centers and chip factories necessary to support the growing demand for AI technology. While the investment marks a significant milestone for the industry, some experts and regulators are raising concerns. The Bank of England has warned that such high levels of debt could potentially threaten global financial stability. Investors and analysts remain divided on whether these expensive projects will provide the expected long-term returns.
summary.zh: 輝達宣布與六家華爾街大型金融機構達成五千億美元的巨額協議，旨在為人工智慧基礎設施提供資金。這項合作旨在建設支援人工智慧技術日益增長需求所需的資料中心與晶片工廠。儘管這項投資對該產業而言是一個重要里程碑，但部分專家與監管機構已提出擔憂。英格蘭銀行警告，如此高水準的債務可能會威脅全球金融穩定。投資人與分析師對於這些昂貴的專案是否能提供預期的長期回報，看法仍然分歧。

paragraphs.en: Nvidia, the world-famous chipmaker, has announced a major partnership with some of the largest financial firms on Wall Street. The company is working with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, and KKR to raise $500 billion. This massive amount of money will be used to build the physical infrastructure needed for the artificial intelligence (AI) boom. According to BBC Business, this is the first time that investors have treated AI hardware—often called "compute"—as a specific type of asset that can be managed and funded like real estate or energy projects.
paragraphs.zh: 全球知名的晶片製造商輝達（Nvidia）宣布與華爾街多家大型金融機構建立重大合作夥伴關係。該公司正與阿波羅全球管理（Apollo）、貝萊德（BlackRock）、黑石集團（Blackstone）、布魯克菲爾德（Brookfield）、高盛（Goldman Sachs）以及 KKR 等機構合作，計畫籌集五千億美元。這筆龐大資金將用於建設人工智慧（AI）熱潮所需的實體基礎設施。根據英國廣播公司商業新聞（BBC Business）報導，這是投資人首次將人工智慧硬體（通常稱為「運算資源」）視為一種特定類型的資產，並像房地產或能源專案一樣進行管理與融資。

paragraphs.en: Jensen Huang, the chief executive of Nvidia, explained that the goal is to help companies get the financing they need to build quickly. Many businesses want to use AI, but they do not have the money or the access to credit required to build large-scale systems. By working with these financial giants, Nvidia hopes to make "AI factories" more accessible. These factories include the data centers that house thousands of computer chips, as well as the new factories needed to manufacture those chips. As noted by The Guardian Business, Huang described this as a major milestone, stating that every industrial revolution in history has relied on new infrastructure, such as electricity or transportation, and that AI is the next step in that process.
paragraphs.zh: 輝達執行長黃仁勳（Jensen Huang）解釋說，此舉的目標是協助企業取得快速建設所需的資金。許多企業渴望應用人工智慧，卻缺乏足夠的資金或信用管道來建立大規模系統。透過與這些金融巨頭合作，輝達希望讓「人工智慧工廠」變得更容易實現。這些工廠包含容納數千個電腦晶片的資料中心，以及製造這些晶片所需的新廠房。正如衛報商業新聞（The Guardian Business）所指出，黃仁勳將此描述為一個重要的里程碑，並表示歷史上每一次工業革命都仰賴電力或交通等新基礎設施，而人工智慧正是該進程中的下一步。

paragraphs.en: This investment comes at a time when the demand for AI technology is growing at an incredible speed. Big technology companies, including Google, Meta, Amazon, and Microsoft, have already spent over $1 trillion on AI projects in the last three years. These companies rely on Nvidia’s graphics processing units (GPUs) to run their AI chatbots and platforms. Because of this, Nvidia’s value has grown five times larger in just three years. According to BBC Business, leaders at KKR noted that while the ambition to build AI is high, the actual delivery of these complex systems is the most difficult part of the process.
paragraphs.zh: 這項投資是在人工智慧技術需求以驚人速度成長之際進行的。包括 Google、Meta、亞馬遜（Amazon）與微軟（Microsoft）在內的大型科技公司，過去三年已在人工智慧專案上投入超過一兆美元。這些公司仰賴輝達的圖形處理器（GPU）來運行其人工智慧聊天機器人與平台。正因如此，輝達的市值在短短三年內成長了五倍。根據英國廣播公司商業新聞報導，KKR 的領導層指出，儘管建設人工智慧的雄心壯志很高，但這些複雜系統的實際交付才是整個過程中難度最高的部分。

paragraphs.en: However, the rapid pace of this spending has caused some concern among financial experts. While many see AI as a way to drive economic growth and productivity, others worry about the risks involved. The Bank of England recently warned that the fast growth of AI development could create problems for financial stability. According to The Guardian Business, the Bank of England reported that if AI companies take on too much debt and fail to make enough profit, it could lead to a "credit crunch." A credit crunch is a situation where it becomes very difficult or expensive for regular businesses and families to borrow money from banks.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，這種快速的支出步伐已引起金融專家的擔憂。雖然許多人將人工智慧視為推動經濟成長與生產力的方式，但其他人則擔心其中涉及的風險。英格蘭銀行（Bank of England）近期警告，人工智慧發展的快速成長可能會對金融穩定造成問題。根據衛報商業新聞報導，英格蘭銀行指出，如果人工智慧公司承擔過多債務卻無法創造足夠利潤，可能會導致「信貸緊縮」。信貸緊縮是指一般企業與家庭難以從銀行借貸，或借貸成本變得極為高昂的情況。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, regulators are worried that financial firms might not fully understand the risks they are taking. The Bank of England noted that because there are many different ways for AI companies to get funding, it is hard for banks to see the full picture of how much money is at risk. If these investments do not perform as well as expected, the impact could be felt across the global economy. Policymakers have suggested that financial firms need to be more careful about how they manage these exposures.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，監管機構擔心金融機構可能無法完全理解其所承擔的風險。英格蘭銀行指出，由於人工智慧公司取得資金的管道多元，銀行很難全面掌握這些資金曝險的程度。如果這些投資的表現不如預期，其影響可能會擴散至全球經濟。政策制定者建議，金融機構在管理這些風險部位時需要更加謹慎。

paragraphs.en: Despite these warnings, the industry continues to move forward. Other companies are also seeking new ways to fund their growth. For example, Anthropic recently reached a deal with Macquarie Asset Management and a Singaporean wealth fund to support its own infrastructure needs. Similarly, BlackRock has entered into a separate deal with Meta to own a data center in Texas. These moves show that the race to build AI capacity is not slowing down.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管有這些警告，該產業仍持續向前邁進。其他公司也在尋求新的方式來資助其成長。例如，人工智慧公司 Anthropic 近期與麥格理資產管理（Macquarie Asset Management）及一家新加坡財富基金達成協議，以支持其自身的基礎設施需求。同樣地，貝萊德也與 Meta 達成了一項獨立協議，將在德州擁有一座資料中心。這些舉措顯示，建立人工智慧產能的競賽並未放緩。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the success of these investments will depend on whether AI can truly deliver the profits that investors expect. Jane Sydenham, a senior investment manager at Rathbones, told BBC Business that while Nvidia is an enormous company that produces the chips everyone needs, there is a lingering question: will all these expensive projects actually earn the right return in the future? For now, the world is watching closely as billions of dollars are poured into the hardware that will define the next generation of technology.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，這些投資的成功將取決於人工智慧是否真能帶來投資人所期待的利潤。拉斯邦投資管理公司（Rathbones）的資深投資經理珍·賽登漢姆（Jane Sydenham）向英國廣播公司商業新聞表示，雖然輝達是一家生產每個人所需晶片的龐大企業，但仍存在一個揮之不去的疑問：這些昂貴的專案未來真的能獲得應有的回報嗎？目前，全世界正密切關注著數十億美元資金湧入這些將定義下一代技術的硬體設備中。

quiz.question: What is the primary purpose of the $500 billion partnership between Nvidia and Wall Street firms?

options.A: To provide direct cash loans to AI startups for daily operations.
options.B: To finance the construction of physical infrastructure like data centers and chip factories.
options.C: To help Google, Meta, and Microsoft pay off their existing $1 trillion debt.
options.D: To purchase shares in Nvidia to stabilize the company's stock price.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段與第二段，這筆資金的目的是為了建立 AI 發展所需的「實體基礎設施」（physical infrastructure），包括資料中心與製造晶片的工廠。選項 A 錯誤，因為資金是用於基礎建設而非營運週轉；選項 C 錯誤，文中提到大型科技公司已自行投入資金，而非透過此計畫還債；選項 D 錯誤，投資目的是為了基礎建設，而非購買 Nvidia 股票。

quiz.question: Why might the Bank of England be concerned about the current trend of AI investment?

options.A: They believe AI technology will eventually make banks obsolete.
options.B: They worry that AI companies are not spending enough money on research.
options.C: They fear that high debt levels in the AI sector could negatively impact the broader economy.
options.D: They think Nvidia is becoming too powerful and should be broken up by regulators.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第四段，英國央行擔心 AI 公司若承擔過多債務且無法獲利，可能引發「信貸緊縮」（credit crunch），進而影響一般民眾與企業的借貸能力，這顯示了金融穩定性的風險。選項 A 文中未提及；選項 B 與文中提到的「投入過快」相反；選項 D 雖提及監管機構擔憂，但並未建議拆分公司，推論過度。

quiz.question: In the context of the final paragraph, what does the word 'lingering' mean?

options.B: Moving very slowly toward a destination.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在文末提到「lingering question」，意指雖然投資持續進行，但關於這些昂貴項目是否能獲利的疑慮依然存在且未消散。選項 B 雖有「慢」的意思，但在這裡指疑慮的存在狀態；選項 C 與疼痛無關；選項 D 與「lingering」的本意「持續存在」完全相反。

quiz.question: Which of the following best summarizes the main message of the article?

options.A: Nvidia has become the most valuable company in the world by selling AI chatbots.
options.B: Wall Street firms are now exclusively investing in AI instead of real estate.
options.C: The rapid expansion of AI infrastructure is driven by massive investment, but it brings significant financial risks.
options.D: The Bank of England has successfully stopped the flow of money into AI projects to protect the economy.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。本文的核心在於報導 Nvidia 與金融機構合作投入龐大資金建設 AI 基礎設施的趨勢，同時也平衡地探討了隨之而來的經濟風險與監管擔憂。選項 A 忽略了基礎建設的主題；選項 B 過度誇大，並非「取代」房地產；選項 D 錯誤，文中僅提到警告，並未表示計畫已被停止。
